comment: Read from the maker's source at commit 7dc3dab, doc/manual.md, and the maker's own ChowTape plugin manual at chowdsp.com. All four knobs are 0 to 1 shown as a percentage and all four default to 0. In cookParams the filter frequency is 200Hz times 100 raised to one minus the amount knob, so amount at 0 leaves it at 20000Hz; the gain is -24dB times the depth knob; the noise gain is 0.33 times depth times amount, so both knobs have to be up for any noise. Variance adds a random offset to both, up to the filter frequency over 0.6 and up to 36dB, redrawn every 64 samples, and the total gain is capped at 3dB. The envelope knob sets the level detector's release between 20ms and 5000ms.
